name: Fetish: Omote no Kioku
source:
Main character returns to his alma mater. Memories overflow him. The sound of laughter draws closer. Even his distant memories pushed at the back of the consciousness start to show up with unprecedented liveliness.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公回到母校，回忆如潮水般涌来。笑声越来越近；连被压在意识最深处的遥远记忆，也以前所未有的鲜活姿态浮现。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-february-2004-forest.html]vndbreview[/url]]
